summary: Alex Morgan is a legendary figure in global association football, widely recognized as one of the most prominent pioneers in the growth of women's soccer. Retired from professional play since September 2024, her status has transitioned into that of an iconic stateswoman and highly active sports business executive. Morgan holds an exceptional commercial footprint with a massive, highly loyal digital following of over 9 million on Instagram alone, rendering her one of the most visible female athletes in the United States. Her personal narrative is deeply layered, merging elite athletic achievement with dedicated advocacy for equal pay, active motherhood, and a rising career as a venture investor. Even post-playing career, her momentum has shifted into high-profile business ventures, including co-founding media group Togethxr, investing in professional women's sports, and securing major long-term brand relationships with brands like CVS Pharmacy, Henkel, and all Laundry. There is minor uncertainty regarding specific private social media performance rates, but her public commercial strength remains category-leading.

evidence.claim: Alex Morgan officially retired from professional soccer in September 2024, playing her final career match on September 8, 2024 with San Diego Wave FC.

evidence.claim: Morgan is a two-time FIFA Women's World Cup Champion (2015, 2019) and Olympic Gold Medalist (2012) with 224 international appearances and 123 goals for the USWNT.
San Diego Wave FC retired Morgan's iconic No. 13 jersey in September 2025, after she became a minority investor in the NWSL club in May 2025.
